meta.rule: A hotel is usable for an 8 AM–close day only if the walk from the lobby to the poker room can be completed inside 30 minutes.
meta.measured_minutes_source: Google Maps walking directions, opened and read on 2026-11-17 for every cross-property hotel->Venetian and hotel->Wynn pair; the route URL, the printed duration, the printed distance and the read date are kept per pair. A routing-engine duration is a measurement, not an operator-published figure, and the on-site internal walks (The Venetian/Palazzo and Wynn/Encore) have no route and stay unmeasured.
meta.how_to_close: Re-open each route URL in data/verify/walking_routes_2026-11-17.tsv and record the new duration and date, or take a lobby-to-poker-room walk on site and publish the measurement with the date it was taken. Update the pairs in data/poker4.json and rebuild; the rows update with the run.
